H0.disclosure: H0 was motivated by a V2D pilot with 2 nulls per family; those nulls are excluded from this test.
H0.H0a: smallest s with seed-mean whole-circuit rate >=50 Hz; above 0.1 censored and tied at top
H0.statistics: analysis_v2.permutation_rank two-sided; Holm across H0a/H0b within family; alpha .05; real minus null median; 2.5 to 97.5 percentile band
H0.secondary: Spearman correlation of s* and mean absolute per-target E/I input-ratio shift

nulls.rule: base + block_index*100000 + family_index*10000 + index*32; family indices N-FULL=0,N-SIGN=1,N-STRENGTH=2; block order H0-STR,H0-FULL,H0-T2,E2a,E3-low,E3-high. Stratum RNG seeds add 0..26.
nulls.excluded: All earlier seed ranges, including 202810150000..202810150226 topology-only pilots; V2E seeds are used only for EXPLORATORY E1 regeneration and the product.
nulls.incomplete_strata: Retain and report without reseeding; global changed-edge gate on pilot T1a and T2 >=50%

exploratory.inference: descriptive percentiles and Spearman only, no p-values or Holm
exploratory.E1: T1a REAL plus all 499 nulls of each of four families; T2 REAL plus first 20 per family
exploratory.E2a: T1a consensus glutamate code 3 treated as excitatory, REAL plus 99 fresh N-SIGN nulls

E2b.reason: Compiled predicted_nt_confidence is copied verbatim, but the source confidence semantics and its relationship to consensus_nt signs are not established. No threshold interpretation is invented.

exploratory.E3: T1a REAL plus 99 fresh N-SIGN nulls separately at nu0=.5 and 5 Hz; full H0 metric definitions

resource_plan.basis: Real-only maximum pilot trial duration applied to all 11 grid points, without early-stop savings; measured topology and real mechanism timing; T1a uses archived V2E real-only full-sweep timing. Saturated null dynamics may cost more. This is a projection, not a runtime guarantee. Single-worker full graph includes 512 MiB memory margin.

early_stop: Ascending grid, stop after first current seed-mean >=50 Hz once .039 evaluated; retain first crossing even if later rates fall. Real graphs full sweeps.
noise: Same interior mask and body IDs as ports-v2.json profile_id ports-v2.1, source noise-v2.json, stream 17, table noise-table-v2.json
statistics: analysis_v2.permutation_rank inclusive two-sided plus-one ties; alpha .05; H0a .11 is censored rank sentinel, not a measurement; exactly all declared nulls required

mechanism.matrix: A[source,target]; s*PSP_UNIT*W; s=.039; PSP_UNIT=unit_psp()[0]; transpose has identical eigenvalues
mechanism.cycles: Distinct vertices, autapses excluded; product of positive contact weights per directed cycle, divided by rotations (2 or 3)
mechanism.reciprocity: Fraction of non-autaptic positive edges with positive reverse edge
mechanism.scc: All N vertices including isolated nodes; positive edges only
mechanism.gini: Absolute signed incoming weight sum, including zero-strength neurons
mechanism.eigen: ARPACK k=1, deterministic ones v0, tol=1e-7,maxiter=5000; report nonconvergence as missing; no retries or substitute spectra

claims: In this model, measured wiring stays stable at couplings where shuffles that also preserve each neuron's binned excitatory and inhibitory connection strength saturate.
The stability difference also holds in the 43,894-neuron circuit, under this model and for the families that reached significance.
The stability difference also holds in the full 166,700-neuron MaleCNS graph, under this model and for the families that reached significance.
reporting: Non-significant or not-run families stated plainly wherever H0 is mentioned; no real-fly necessity claim. All exploratory outputs labeled EXPLORATORY.
freeze: No manifest member may change after freeze. Defect stops execution. Public tag and branch required before null simulation.
